item.text: South Australia’s Independent Commission Against Corruption evaluated controls over medical officers’ professional development funds in the health department and two local health networks.
item.support: the extent to which these practices, policies and procedures effectively manage the risks of corruption.

item.text: It reviewed policies, claims data, supporting documents and staff interviews to assess how the funds were administered.
item.support: an examination of all supporting documentation relating to a random selection of claims

item.text: The Commission concluded that clearer definitions and procedures were needed to limit discretion and reduce the risk of funds being misused.
item.support: There is a need for clear definitions, policies and procedures to reduce discretion and to guide decision-making.

item.text: Its eight recommendations covered eligible expenses, approval and reimbursement systems, detection of duplicate claims and audits.
item.support: The evaluation has identified areas vulnerable to corruption and makes eight recommendations to address these risks.
